title: Candidate extraction v2: endorsements precision
instructions:
### What the model was told to extract
Endorsements of the candidate from the campaign website. The candidate's own statements, calls to endorse, and generic supporter counts are not endorsements.
- endorser_name identifies the person or entity only.
- entity_type is individual, organization, or unclear.
- endorser_category is private_individual, government_official, party_official, labor_union, media_outlet, other_organization, other_individual, or unclear.
- title, affiliation, and jurisdiction are separate nullable fields. They are never combined and never inferred.
- record_evidence is one exact unique name-bearing span.
- support_mode is explicit_text only when record_evidence itself states support. A bare name never qualifies.

### Review rule
- Judge only the archived page shown here.
- Answer each dimension independently.
- Read the help text on a question before you answer no.
- Use Notes when a no answer needs clarification.
- A bare name needs support from exact segment or parent-page context, or from the explicitly labeled classifier-qualified historical endorsement-page URL context.
- Do not infer title, affiliation, jurisdiction, or organization.

Public Figures
John Vincent is about to become my colleague and the next congressman from South Carolina's beautiful 7th District.
I've been traveling all over the country, and everywhere I go, we have amazing candidates surging and overflow crowds showing up. It's becoming clear to the country that the party of democracy and freedom is also the party of progress.
The other side has nothing to offer working families but inflation out of control: gasoline and diesel prices, groceries, mortgages, rent, and everything else. John is a magnificent candidate, and I'm deeply committed and invested in his campaign and his success.
I like to tell young people that everything they need to know about voting is everything they need to know about driving. If you want to go forward, you put it in D. If you want to go backwards, you put it in R. It's time to move forward with John Vincent."
Congressman Jamie Raskin (MD-08)
- Ranking Member, House Judiciary Committee
From the Pee Dee to the Grand Strand
, the people of South Carolina’s 7th District need a champion who will fight for jobs, opportunity, and a fair shot for every family.  John Vincent is that leader, and I’m proud to support his campaign for Congress."
Jaime Harrison
- former Chair of the Democratic National Committee and one of South Carolina's most respected political leaders.
"I am delighted to endorse John Vincent,
who has spent the past year doing the real work of building trust with communities."
Marilyn Hemingway
- Chair of the Georgetown County Democratic Party
strongly
endorse John Vincent
because this is a moment that demands proven leadership."

John was absolutely the best."

- John's former Commanding Officer on L. Mendel Rivers

I proudly endorse John Gregory Vincent."

John Gregory Vincent for US Congress."

reflects a clear understanding of the issues that matter most—not only to middle-class families, but also to the men and women who serve in demanding and often overlooked roles, including correctional officers and staff."

— recognizing a 20-year Navy veteran whose focus on results over partisanship reflects exactly the kind of leadership the Forward movement is built around."

YOUR VOICE MATTERS.
ADD IT TO OURS.
Every movement starts with people who are willing to stand up and say:
"I believe in this."
If you believe South Carolina's 7th District deserves a representative who puts
people over politics
— someone who will fight for affordable healthcare, quality schools, good-paying jobs, and the dignity of every community in our district — we want to hear from you.
Add your name to our endorsement wall today.
Whether you are an individual, a community leader, a business owner, or an organization, your endorsement sends a powerful message: that change is coming to SC-7, and you are part of it.

Add your personal endorsement statement here:
Endorse Mac Deford for Congress
“I am proud to endorse Mac Deford. The people of the Lowcountry deserve a Congressperson that will fight for them and fight to defend Social Security. Because make no mistake about it, with House Republicans like Nancy Mace in charge, Social Security is under attack every single day. So vote for Mac Deford. For you, for all of the people of the Lowcountry, and to fight for Social Security.”
– Gov. Martin O’Malley, former Governor of Maryland and Social Security Commissioner
“Working people across South Carolina need leaders who understand the challenges facing workers and families. Your commitment to these values and your willingness to stand with working people have earned the support of our labor movement. We believe your leadership will help move South Carolina forward and ensure that the voices of working people are heard at every level of government.”
– South Carolina AFL-CIO
“Over the last few years, I’ve enjoyed working with Mac to elevate veteran and quality of life issues impacting the Lowcountry. I appreciate his dedication to service to our nation and state. He will be a needed credible voice in Congress.”
-Senator Ed Sutton, U.S. Air Force veteran
“Mac Deford is exactly who the Lowcountry needs in Congress right now. He has spent nearly two decades building a life and a career here, protecting our coast in the U.S. Coast Guard and serving as a local government attorney working on the issues that matter most to our families. He knows our challenges from the ground up, whether that is affordable housing, protecting our environment, or advocating for overlooked communities. That is the kind of experience and commitment you cannot manufacture. I am proud to endorse Mac for Congress.”
– Representative Courtney Waters
North Charleston, SC
“I support Mac because he understands what is important to the success of the Lowcountry. As the former Assistant United States Trade Representative, I know how essential global trade is to South Carolina. The aerospace, auto, and battery industries, as well as the ports that help these businesses thrive, are creating high-paying jobs that support the economy and quality of life we cherish here in South Carolina. The current administration’s incoherent and capricious trade agenda is a threat to these very businesses, jobs, and careers that make the Lowcountry the place we want to call home.”
– Gail Strickler, former Asst. U.S. Trade Representative under President Obama
Kiawah Island, SC
“Throughout my career as a U.S. diplomat, I learned the value of principled leadership and steady judgment. Mac brings both. He understands that America’s strength comes from integrity at home and credibility abroad, and he has the temperament and vision to serve with honor in Congress.”
– Chris Richardson, Former U.S. Diplomat, Attorney
James Island, SC
I enthusiastically endorse Mac Deford for Congress in SC-01. Mac has long worked throughout our community from Mt. Pleasant to Hilton Head Island, shares Lynne’s and my core Democratic Party values, and will deliver what our Lowcountry needs to reinvigorate our economy, lower consumer costs, and address healthcare and similar affordability issues. He will restore integrity and accountability to a broken Congress.
– Colonel Blaine Lotz, U.S. Air Force (ret.)
Former Beaufort County Democratic Party Chair
Hilton Head Island, SC
“Mac has been fighting for the people of the Lowcountry long before he ran for office. He’ll fight for us in Congress. He’ll defend the rule of law. And he’ll stand up to this corrupt, cruel administration. That’s the kind of bold leadership we need.”
– Alexia Niketas,
Attorney
Summerville, SC

KY Rep. William Lawrence Endorses Andy Barr for U.S. Senate
Endorsements
January 21, 2026
Maysville, Kentucky—
Today, Kentucky State Representative William Lawrence (R-HD-70) endorsed Andy Barr for U.S. Senate.
“I seldom make endorsements but Andy Barr is a man I know, trust, and proudly call a friend. He’s always just a phone call away — and with a schedule like his, that means a great deal,”
said Rep. Lawrence.
“Andy keeps his word and has repeatedly delivered for Fleming County and communities across his district. That’s why I’m asking Kentuckians to support and vote for my friend Andy Barr for the United States Senate.”
“I’m honored to earn Rep. Lawrence’s support,”
said Barr.
“William is a strong voice for Eastern Kentucky in Frankfort. Together, we will keep fighting for our communities, stand up for our values, and deliver results for every corner of the Commonwealth.”
Representative Lawrence was first elected in 2020. The 70th House District includes Bracken, Harrison, Mason, and Robertson Counties. Rep. Lawrence joins twenty other sitting members of the Kentucky House of Representatives in backing Barr for Senate. Barr has more than 160 major endorsements in the Kentucky Senate race, more than all of his opponents combined.

Senator
Senator Tim Kaine
Beth Macy is who we need in Congress. She shows up for all of us. She does her homework and diligently gathers facts to find solutions. She is eminently skilled at listening and works arduously to give voice to hard-working Americans left behind in these changing times. Beth is the real deal. She gives me hope that we can come together, joined by common principles, to make the American dream within reach for all.
Senator
Senator Mark Warner
Beth Macy has spent more than two decades telling the stories that Washington too often ignores. Her reporting on the opioid epidemic didn’t just win awards – it changed the national conversation and gave voice to communities that needed someone to fight for them. We need Beth in Congress to make life affordable for working families, protecting and expand access to health care, and invest in rural communities to make sure folks don’t have to leave their hometown to find a world class job.
Governor
Abigail Spanberger
“Beth Macy has spent four decades telling the stories of outsiders and underdogs — from reporting on offshoring jobs to shining a light on the devastating impacts of the opioid crisis.. As Republicans in Washington continue to make life more expensive for Virginia families, Beth is stepping up to lower costs and get things done for the people of Virginia. In Congress, Beth will do what she has always done: promoting opportunity, affordability, and dignity for working families. I’m proud to endorse her candidacy.”
Anita James Price
“Charles and I heartily endorse Beth Macy’s campaign for Congress. We’ve known her for almost four decades, and she has always uplifted our projects, especially the Harrison Museum of African American Culture. As a former city council member, I am pleased to support someone whose work has always been about supporting communities—ALL communities—in our region.”
Roanoke Mayor
Sherman Lea, Sr.
“Beth Macy has been advocating for Roanoke for four decades. She’s the fighter we need to send to Washington to stand up for us—a new voice, one who will fight for all her constituents, not just billionaires. I heartily endorse her campaign.”
Roanoke City Sheriff
Antonio D. Hash
“Beth Macy has consistently championed the rights of individuals whose voices have been suppressed. She’s been a staunch advocate for evidence-based treatment in jail/detention centers, which we understand to be beneficial in safeguarding our communities. Now she’s bringing that fight to the halls of Congress, and I’m proud to endorse her candidacy.”
Roanoke Mayor
Joe Cobb
“Beth Macy meets us where we are. She listens. She learns. She acts.
After years of having our voices squelched, the Roanoke Valley needs a local representative” in Congress,
a person who knows Southwest Virginians and has been illuminating their stories for decades.
She brought Big Pharma to its knees and knows how to hold corporate America accountable.
Beth works for us to make our lives better.”
Radford Mayor
David Horton
“I am proud to endorse Beth Macy for the Democratic nomination to represent Virginia’s Sixth Congressional District. I have known Beth since her years at The Roanoke Times, where she stood shoulder to shoulder with the people of the New River Valley and Southwest Virginia. She understands this region because she has lived its stories and earned its trust. I believe she will bring to Congress a fresh perspective grounded in the values, resilience, and work ethic of Southwest Virginia, and with your support, she will be a strong and compassionate advocate for the Sixth District.”
Harrisonburg Mayor
Deanna Reed
“Beth Macy will fight for working people because that’s who she is. She will advocate to restore cuts to Medicaid, Head Start, and federally funded programs that support the homeless here in Harrisonburg. She will fight to dethrone ICE, which is terrorizing our neighbors and has deported more than 400 people in the region this past year. I heartily endorse her candidacy to become the Sixth District’s first congresswoman.”
Charlottesville Community leader
Dr. Sanjay Kishore
“I am proud to support Beth Macy for Congress. I had the good fortune of meeting Beth over a decade ago as a medical student: through her writing and advocacy on behalf of Virginians stuggling with addiction, she taught me what it means to lead with love, compassion, and dignity-values I strive to embody every time I care for a patient. As a new parent, I often feel what so many across our state and nation do-fear and uncertainty about the world ahead. Beth not only gives me hope that a better future is possible-she gives me faith that we can build it if we ave the courage to fight for it together.”
Roanoke Community leader
Dr. Cheri Hartman
“I am proud to support Beth Macy for Congress. I had the good fortune of meeting Beth over a decade ago as a medical student: through her writing and advocacy on behalf of Virginians stuggling with addiction, she taught me what it means to lead with love, compassion, and dignity-values I strive to embody every time I care for a patient. As a new parent, I often feel what so many across our state and nation do-fear and uncertainty about the world ahead. Beth not only gives me hope that a better future is possible-she gives me faith that we can build it if we ave the courage to fight for it together.”
Roanoke Community leader
Salena Sullivan
“I have known Beth for almost 20 years, and I cannot think of anyone who would better represent the 6th District’s interests in Congress. She is a hard worker, an even fiercer researcher, thoughtful, caring, compassionate, and most of all, ethical. She will fight for what she thinks is right. She loves people and will listen to everyone she represents before making a thoughtful, informed decision. Beth will fight for equality, fairness, and helping others.”
retired U.S. Space Force colonel
Bree Fram
“I’ve seen Beth’s commitment to understanding the lives and challenges of the people she seeks to represent. She knows that public service isn’t about being the loudest voice in the room, it’s about understanding, telling the truth, and ensuring everyone has a voice at the table.
The people of Virginia’s Sixth deserve a representative who will work to lift up every community in the district. I believe Beth Macy will be that kind of representative, and I’m proud to support her campaign for Congress.”
Tim Kaine

We don’t need leaders who pick and choose when to stand up for people. Democrats deserve a candidate who will show up in every room and fight for everyone. That’s why I’m proud to support Dakarai Larriett.
Alabama For Progress
For the U.S. Senate seat currently held by Tommy Tuberville, Alabama for Progress endorses Dakarai Larriett! His campaign and candidacy are rooted in a belief in fundamental progress in every area Alabamians, and Americans at large, need it in. With a long history as a progressive and clearly outlined goals for his potential senatorial term, Mr. Larriett would be Alabama's best progressive fighter in the upper chamber of Congress.
Progressive Voters Network
Dakarai Larriett stands as a bold fighter against the entrenched systems of oppression that have long plagued working people in Alabama and across the nation. Larriett calls for eliminating qualified immunity. Implementing a Motorist Bill of Rights and redirecting resources from the school-to-prison pipeline toward education and mental health. This is the kind of unapologetic resistance we need: defunding the tools of state violence while building community power.
For the Future Victory Fund
The Senate requires a voice that is both strategic and compassionate-a leader who understands that national progress is measured by the strength of our communities. Dakarai Larriett has demonstrated the unique ability to navigate complex challenges with a focus on long-term stability and inclusive growth. He is the champion our state needs to ensure our voice is heard with clarity and conviction in Washington.

Why Dakarai Larriett is the Choice for the Future: Dakarai is committed to modernizing our national infrastructure, focusing on sustainable energy and digital connectivity to ensure no community is left behind in the modern economy. He brings a balanced approach to federal spending, advocating for policies that stimulate middle-class growth while ensuring corporate accountability. With a track record of listening to local stakeholders, Dakarai's legislative priorities are rooted in the real-world needs of his constituents, from criminal justice reform to affordable housing.

Dakarai Larriett possesses the rare combination of high-level strategic intellect and a genuine heart for public service. He isn't interested in the status quo; he is interested in results that elevate every citizen.

The stakes for the future of our country have never been higher. For The Future Victory Fund is fully committed to seeing Dakarai Larriett in the Senate, where he will work tirelessly to build a more resilient and equitable nation.
Alabama Highschool Democrats
We are proud and honored to endorse Mr. Dakarai Larriett for U.S. Senate! He has shown major commitment to empowering and growing the youth and student activities and engagement in the state. He is a servant leader and he will do what is best for the people of Alabama, especially during these crucial times. His stances on education, jobs, and the community made this decision fairly easy to make and we know he'll lead Alabama in the right direction. He leads faithfully and works on making this state more equitable and bringing justice to all in Alabama!
College Democrats at the University of Alabama at Birmingham
We are proud to endorse Dakarai Larriett for US Senate. A man ready to put in the work.
University of Alabama New Liberals
Dakarai is a community-driven and focused leader with a strong ability to connect to anyone he meets. We are confident that he will make meaningful change and serve the people of Alabama well as our democratic nominee and one day, on Capitol Hill.
Kelvin Datcher
Member, Alabama House of Representatives
I wholeheartedly endorse Dakarai Larriett for the United States Senate. Throughout my time getting to know Dakarai, I’ve witnessed his unwavering commitment to our community. He’s been a dynamic presence on the political stage, actively engaging with organizations like the Congressional Black Caucus and tirelessly advocating for workers' rights in Birmingham.

This is the type of leadership we desperately need in Washington—an advocate who will not forget the people when he gets there. The stakes in this election couldn't be higher. We need to ensure that dedicated individuals like Dakarai are in positions of power, ready to fight for our rights every single day. Let’s rally together and support a candidate who will truly represent us!
Bobby J. Johnson
Community Leader, Reform, AL
Dakarai Larriett is my choice to represent the state of Alabama in the United States Senate. Dakarai is totally in tune with the needs of the community and never fails to deliver hands-on leadership. It is my honor to endorse and recommend him for this crucial role at this critical moment!
Ke’Undra Cox
Chief Executive Officer, Brighter Future America
I am proud to offer my full support for Dakarai Larriett as the next United States Senator for the State of Alabama. As I have had the opportunity to get to know him, my respect and admiration for his leadership have only grown. Dakarai Larriett genuinely cares about the people of Alabama, and I am confident he will fight tirelessly in Washington to put our state first and deliver meaningful results for our communities.
Dr. Mark A. Haynes
Community Activist
I proudly support Dakarai Larriett for U.S. Senate because Alabama needs a leader who listens, leads, and delivers. Alabama deserves bold, ethical leadership that puts people first. I am proud to stand with Dakarai Larriett.

West Alabama Community Leader
I wholeheartedly recommend Dakarai Larriett for the United States Senate. From the moment he addressed our civic group in Tuscaloosa, I knew he would be the strongest candidate this cycle. As a businessman, community leader, and advocate for disenfranchised groups, Dakarai understands the needs of our communities and fights for justice and equality. His dedication to uplifting those who are often overlooked is why I fully support his candidacy.

Jim Marter’s campaign for Congress in Illinois’ 14th District continues to build a list of personal and organizational endorsements.
He is the three times elected, Chairman of the Kendall County GOP
, in the heart of the new IL14. He was a 2024 Presidential Delegate, Donald J. Trump, 14th Congressional District. He served on the RCCA (Rep. County Chairman’s Association), as the Regional VP for Collar Counties.
He was selected as the Illinois 2020 14
District Presidential Elector. Illinois Conservative Union – former Advisory Board Member.
www.ILPAC.org
He previously served in the role of Deputy for Illinois’ 14th Congressional District on the GOP’s State Central Committee and was a local elected official in his hometown of Oswego, Illinois where he served as an Oswego Library District Board Trustee (2021-2025)
His only opponent running in the primary does not live in the district and therefore can’t vote for himself.
As the list shows, Jim Marter has a strong grassroots network at the local, district and state level, as well as nationally known issue experts, lending their support and expertise. He is ready for the job and best positioned to replace Democrat Lauren Underwood.

Kentucky Professional Fire Fighters Unanimously Endorses Andy Barr for Senate
Endorsements
May 22, 2025
The largest association of professional firefighters and emergency medical technicians (EMTs) is behind Barr
Lexington, Kentucky—
Today, U.S. Senate candidate Andy Barr (R-KY) scored major endorsements: the International Association of Fire Fighters (IAFF) and the Kentucky Professional Fire Fighters (KPFF), the IAFF’s Kentucky affiliate. The IAFF represents 356,000 professional firefighters and EMTs. Barr has long championed Kentucky firefighters and EMTs in Congress, and has been endorsed by IAFF six times.
“Our firefighters and EMT professionals are heroes,”
said Andy Barr.
“Firefighters and EMT professionals often risk their lives to serve our communities and keep us safe. I’m honored to have the endorsement of the KPFF and IAFF, which represents these great Americans in Kentucky and nationwide. I’m looking forward to being their champion in the U.S. Senate.”
“The KPFF’s unanimous decision reflects Congressman Barr’s strong record of supporting key fire fighter priorities during his tenure in the U.S. House of Representatives,”
said KPFF President Joe Baer.
“From expanding the AFG and SAFER grant programs to repealing the unfair WEP and GPO penalties on retirees – and on many more issues in between – Congressman Andy Barr has stood with fire fighters and their families when it matters most,”
said International Association of Fire Fighters General President Edward Kelly.
“The IAFF looks forward to him continuing his support for Kentucky’s fire fighters in the U.S. Senate.”

Jim Marter’s campaign for Congress in Illinois’ 14th District continues to build a list of personal and organizational endorsements.

We don’t need leaders who pick and choose when to stand up for people. Democrats deserve a candidate who will show up in every room and fight for everyone. That’s why I’m proud to support Dakarai Larriett.
Alabama For Progress
For the U.S. Senate seat currently held by Tommy Tuberville, Alabama for Progress endorses Dakarai Larriett! His campaign and candidacy are rooted in a belief in fundamental progress in every area Alabamians, and Americans at large, need it in. With a long history as a progressive and clearly outlined goals for his potential senatorial term, Mr. Larriett would be Alabama's best progressive fighter in the upper chamber of Congress.
Progressive Voters Network
Dakarai Larriett stands as a bold fighter against the entrenched systems of oppression that have long plagued working people in Alabama and across the nation. Larriett calls for eliminating qualified immunity. Implementing a Motorist Bill of Rights and redirecting resources from the school-to-prison pipeline toward education and mental health. This is the kind of unapologetic resistance we need: defunding the tools of state violence while building community power.
For the Future Victory Fund
The Senate requires a voice that is both strategic and compassionate-a leader who understands that national progress is measured by the strength of our communities. Dakarai Larriett has demonstrated the unique ability to navigate complex challenges with a focus on long-term stability and inclusive growth. He is the champion our state needs to ensure our voice is heard with clarity and conviction in Washington.

Why Dakarai Larriett is the Choice for the Future: Dakarai is committed to modernizing our national infrastructure, focusing on sustainable energy and digital connectivity to ensure no community is left behind in the modern economy. He brings a balanced approach to federal spending, advocating for policies that stimulate middle-class growth while ensuring corporate accountability. With a track record of listening to local stakeholders, Dakarai's legislative priorities are rooted in the real-world needs of his constituents, from criminal justice reform to affordable housing.

Dakarai Larriett possesses the rare combination of high-level strategic intellect and a genuine heart for public service. He isn't interested in the status quo; he is interested in results that elevate every citizen.

The stakes for the future of our country have never been higher. For The Future Victory Fund is fully committed to seeing Dakarai Larriett in the Senate, where he will work tirelessly to build a more resilient and equitable nation.
Alabama Highschool Democrats
We are proud and honored to endorse Mr. Dakarai Larriett for U.S. Senate! He has shown major commitment to empowering and growing the youth and student activities and engagement in the state. He is a servant leader and he will do what is best for the people of Alabama, especially during these crucial times. His stances on education, jobs, and the community made this decision fairly easy to make and we know he'll lead Alabama in the right direction. He leads faithfully and works on making this state more equitable and bringing justice to all in Alabama!
College Democrats at the University of Alabama at Birmingham
We are proud to endorse Dakarai Larriett for US Senate. A man ready to put in the work.
University of Alabama New Liberals
Dakarai is a community-driven and focused leader with a strong ability to connect to anyone he meets. We are confident that he will make meaningful change and serve the people of Alabama well as our democratic nominee and one day, on Capitol Hill.
Kelvin Datcher
Member, Alabama House of Representatives
I wholeheartedly endorse Dakarai Larriett for the United States Senate. Throughout my time getting to know Dakarai, I’ve witnessed his unwavering commitment to our community. He’s been a dynamic presence on the political stage, actively engaging with organizations like the Congressional Black Caucus and tirelessly advocating for workers' rights in Birmingham.

This is the type of leadership we desperately need in Washington—an advocate who will not forget the people when he gets there. The stakes in this election couldn't be higher. We need to ensure that dedicated individuals like Dakarai are in positions of power, ready to fight for our rights every single day. Let’s rally together and support a candidate who will truly represent us!
Bobby J. Johnson
Community Leader, Reform, AL
Dakarai Larriett is my choice to represent the state of Alabama in the United States Senate. Dakarai is totally in tune with the needs of the community and never fails to deliver hands-on leadership. It is my honor to endorse and recommend him for this crucial role at this critical moment!

Planned Parenthood Action Fund
“Planned Parenthood Action Fund is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election to Congress because he has never wavered in his defense of reproductive freedom and essential health care. When Donald Trump and his allies launched attacks on abortion access and voted to “defund” Planned Parenthood, Brad fought back. We know that he will continue fighting to restore funding and protect care for millions of Americans who rely on Planned Parenthood health centers for cancer screenings, birth control, and so many other life-saving reproductive health care services.
“From helping pass the Affordable Care Act to opposing every effort to roll back coverage, Brad Sherman has consistently put people over politics. With abortion access and reproductive freedom under attack, we need his continued leadership in Congress."
International Association of Fire Fighters
“Brad Sherman is a proven ally and has been a strong partner with frontline firefighters and paramedics. He has been an effective leader for public safety, fighting for critical resources and investments in life-saving fire fighting technologies. The International Association of Fire Fighters is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for Congress. He has always been there for firefighters — and we are pleased to support his re-election campaign.”
Los Angeles County Federation of Labor
“The Los Angeles County Federation of Labor is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election because he has been a consistent and effective champion for working families throughout his time in Congress. Brad has always stood with workers to protect good-paying jobs, defend collective bargaining, and make sure our economy works for everyone, not just those at the top. At a time when working people are under attack, we need Brad Sherman’s proven leadership and unwavering commitment to fighting for us in Washington.”
Equality California
“Brad Sherman has been a consistent and unwavering champion for LGBTQ+ equality in Congress. From fighting back against the Trump Administration's attacks to helping block anti-trans legislation in the House to working tirelessly to defend reproductive freedom and LGBTQ+ civil rights, Brad understands that our community deserves pro-equality champions who deliver results. Equality California is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election because we know he will continue to be a strong ally and partner in the fight for full, lived equality for all.”
Avance Democratic Club
"Avance Democratic Club is pleased to give our enthusiastic support and endorsement to Congressman Brad Sherman. He has been a force for good in Congress, fighting back against Donald Trump and ICE, supporting immigrants, working people and our community. He is the best choice for the people of the 32nd District."
Southern California Armenian Democrats
"The Armenian community is united behind Congressman Brad Sherman. He has been one of the most vocal supporters of our community in the House of Representatives. Brad has been a leader who shows up, listens, is accessible, and who we know we can count on to fight for our community. We look forward to helping him get re-elected."
California Governor Gavin Newsom
"Brad Sherman has been a leader in the fight to protect the people of California against Donald Trump. He's been an effective member of Congress for the 32nd District, working to lift up working families, seniors, young people and our most vulnerable. We need Brad to keep up the fight for California in Congress. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election."
Congresswoman Maxine Waters
“Brad Sherman has never backed down from standing up for what’s right. Whether it’s protecting working families or fighting back against Donald Trump’s dangerous agenda, Brad has always been a strong and steady voice for justice. His experience and tenacity make him an invaluable member of Congress, and I’m proud to endorse him.”
Congresswoman Sarah McBride
“Brad Sherman has been a steadfast and effective champion for LGBTQ+ equality, standing strong against discrimination and using his leadership in Congress to advance dignity, safety, and freedom for all. From protecting marriage equality to fighting back against the Trump Administration's attacks on brave transgender servicemembers, Brad has never wavered. At this moment, when our fundamental freedoms are under constant threat, we must stand with proven leaders like Brad Sherman and work together to take back the House of Representatives so we can continue moving our country forward. I am proud to support my friend Brad Sherman for re-election.”
State Superintendent of Public Instruction Tony Thurmond
"Brad Sherman has been a longtime champion for public education, for working families and for our California values. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election for Congress. We need him to keep up the fight for California's students, public educators and working families."
California State Treasurer Fiona Ma, CPA
"Brad Sherman has been a deeply effective member of Congress on behalf of the people of California. He's been a champion for working women and men, helped pass President Obama's Affordable Care Act, invested more in fire fighting and emergency response, helped combat climate change by funding renewable energy like wind and solar and so much more. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election for Congress."
Assembly Democratic Caucus Chair Rick Chavez Zbur
“Brad Sherman has spent his career defending our California values — from protecting reproductive freedom and advancing LGBTQ+ equality to fighting climate change and standing strong against the Trump Administration’s lawless attacks on our communities. I know Brad will continue to be a champion for all Californians in Congress, and I’m proud to support him.”
Los Angeles City Councilmember Traci Park
"Brad Sherman has been an effective leader for our community in Congress. He's fought for critical public safety resources, infrastructure investments that have helped create local jobs and he's been a bold fighter for the people of Los Angeles for years. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election to Congress."
Teamsters Joint Council 42
“The members of the Teamsters Joint Council 42 are excited to announce our enthusiastic endorsement of Brad Sherman for Congress. In the US House of Representatives, Brad has been an effective voice on behalf of working families. Brad Sherman is an ally - he has stood shoulder to shoulder with us - and we are pleased to stand with him as he campaigns for re-election.”
Amalgamated Transit Union Local 1277
"Brad Sherman is an ally, a partner and a warrior for working families. That's why the members of the Amalgamated Transit Union Local 1277 proudly endorse his re-election to Congress."
IAM Union District Lodge 947
“Brad Sherman is a champion for working families. He has been a fighter for workers’ rights and more good paying middle class jobs. The IAM District 947 is proud to endorse Brad Sherman’s re-election for Congress.”
International Union of Operating Engineers Local 12
“The International Union of Operating Engineers Local 12 is pleased to endorse Brad Sherman’s re-election to Congress. Brad has been a champion for our members and working families across Southern California. He has built up a proven record of fighting for better wages, workers’ rights, healthcare access, and retirement security. We know he will continue fighting for our members in the US House of Representatives which is why we are proud to stand with him.”
International Union of Painters and Allied Trades District Council 36
"Brad Sherman is a champion for working families. That's why the International Union of Painters and Allied Trades District Council 36 enthusiastically endorse his re-election to Congress. Brad has been a force for good -- and an effective voice for our members in Congress."
Sheet Metal Workers Local 105
“Workers need fighters in Congress who stand with the labor movement, pushing for workers’ rights, better wages, investments in infrastructure to create jobs, healthcare access and retirement security. Brad Sherman has stood shoulder to shoulder with us for decades. He is an ally, a warrior and a steadfast passer with us. That is precisely why the members of SMART Local 105 are pleased to announce our enthusiastic endorsement of Brad Sherman’s re-election for Congress. “
United Association Local 250
“Brad Sherman has been a fierce and bold voice for working people. He has been an ally in the fight for more good paying union jobs, healthcare access, workers’ rights and retirement security. For these reasons and many more, the members of United Association (UA) Local 250 are proud to endorse Brad Sherman’s re-election to Congress.”
Former LACDP Chair Jimmie Woods Gray*
“As the former Chair of the Los Angeles County Democratic Party, I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman for Congress. Brad is a fighter for working women and men, and for justice and equality for every community. We need him in Washington fighting against Donald Trump and to keep delivering for his district.”

News
With science under attack in Washington, D.C...
Dr. Pan’s presence in Congress would be a step toward opposing Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
American Federation of State, County and Municipal Employees
“Dr. Richard Pan doesn’t just talk about standing with working people - he delivers”
said Alia Griffing, Political Director of AFSCME California.
“He has a proven record of fighting for affordable health care, safe workplaces, and economic security for all Californians. At a moment when the cost of living is soaring and working families are under attack, Californians need a fighter like Dr. Pan in Washington which is why AFSCME is proud to endorse Dr. Pan for Congress.”
California Federation of Labor Unions, AFL-CIO
“Dr. Richard Pan has always stood with workers – not just in words, but in action,”
said Lorena Gonzalez, President of the California Federation of Labor Unions, AFL-CIO,
“From expanding access to affordable health care to supporting the right to organize, he has delivered real results for working families. We’re proud to make him our sole endorsement in CA-06 because we know he will continue to fight for workers in Congress.”
California Federation of Teachers
“Dr. Richard Pan has spent his career standing up for children, families, and public education,”
said Jeffery Freitas, CFT President.
“As a pediatrician, educator, and legislator, he understands that strong schools depend on healthy students, supported educators and classified staff, and communities where families can thrive. CFT is proud to endorse Dr. Pan for Congress because he has the experience, values, and record to deliver for California’s students and working families.”
California Teachers Association
“Dr. Pan has been a steadfast partner to educators in the Legislature, working to protect student health and ensure our schools have the support they need,”
said CTA President David Goldberg
“California’s educators know he will bring that same commitment to Washington.”
California School Employees Association
“The California School Employees Association and our quarter million members proudly endorse Dr. Richard Pan for U.S. Congress. He understands that when we invest in students, we strengthen our entire future. Strong public schools depend on the dedicated classified employees who serve students every day, and Dr. Pan has consistently stood up for safe campuses, healthy learning environments, and the resources students need to thrive. He is the champion our students, schools, and members need in Washington, D.C.,”
said Adam Weinberger, President of the California School Employees Association.
Equality California
“Now more than ever, we need to elect pro-equality leaders with proven track records who have shown clear and consistent support for LGBTQ+ people and who understand what is at stake,”
said Equality California Executive Director Tony Hoang.
“In the legislature, Dr. Pan fought to improve access to healthcare for LGBTQ+ Californians. Throughout his career, he has stood with our community, and we are proud to stand with him.”
International Association of Fire Fighters
“Dr. Richard Pan has spent his career standing up for the health and safety of our communities,”
said Trevor Jamison, President of the Sacramento Area Firefighters.
“When local governments faced budget deficits, Dr. Pan secured federal funding to keep neighborhood fire stations open. We know he will continue to fight for the resources and protections our communities deserve in Congress.”
International Brotherhood of Teamsters - Joint Council 7
“Dr. Richard Pan has consistently stood with working people and understands the issues our members face every day,”
said Dale Wentz, Principal Officer for Teamsters Local 150. “
He has a proven record of delivering for workers and their families, and we are proud to endorse him for Congress.”
Service Employees International Union
“Dr. Richard Pan has consistently stood up for Californians as a union member, a pediatrician, and a legislator,”
said Anica Walls, President of SEIU 1000 and Executive Board Member of SEIU California State Council.
“He understands that every person deserves access to quality health care, safe workplaces, and economic security. SEIU California is proud to endorse Dr. Pan because he has a proven record of delivering real results for working people and their families.”
314 Action Fund
“Dr. Richard Pan has the expertise, knowledge, and experience needed to stand up to Trump and Republicans in Congress,”
said Shaughnessy Naughton, President of 314 Action Fund
. “Not only has Dr. Pan delivered real results for California families, but he’s taken on RFK Jr. twice after preventable disease outbreaks. There’s no one better equipped to meet this moment than Dr. Pan. As a Guardian of Public Health, he will deliver real results as he works to better the lives of everyone in the district. We’re proud to endorse Dr. Pan and look forward to supporting his campaign.”

KY Rep. Robert Duvall Endorses Andy Barr for U.S. Senate
Endorsements
November 7, 2025
Bowling Green, Kentucky—
Today, Kentucky State Representative Robert Duvall (R-HD-17) endorsed Andy Barr for U.S. Senate.
“We need a proven leader to go to the U.S. Senate and fight for our entire Commonwealth,”
said Rep. Duvall.
“Andy Barr will hit the ground running as our next Senator and will continue the great work he’s been doing with President Trump to cut taxes, secure the border, and deliver for Kentucky. I’m proud to endorse him and can’t wait to work with him when he’s our U.S. Senator.”
“As an Optometrist and as a State Representative, Dr. Duvall has always served the people of South-Central Kentucky,”
said Barr.
“Dr. Duvall has worked to create jobs in Kentucky and has led at a state-level to Make America Healthy Again. I’m honored to have one of the champions of the MAHA movement in Kentucky behind my campaign.”
Dr. Duvall was first elected to the Kentucky State House in 2023. His district includes part of Warren County. Dr. Duvall has practiced as an Optometrist in Bowling Green for over 30 years and attended Western Kentucky University along with his wife and 3 sons. He received his doctorate from the University of Alabama at Birmingham School of Optometry.

Planned Parenthood Action Fund
“Planned Parenthood Action Fund is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election to Congress because he has never wavered in his defense of reproductive freedom and essential health care. When Donald Trump and his allies launched attacks on abortion access and voted to “defund” Planned Parenthood, Brad fought back. We know that he will continue fighting to restore funding and protect care for millions of Americans who rely on Planned Parenthood health centers for cancer screenings, birth control, and so many other life-saving reproductive health care services.
“From helping pass the Affordable Care Act to opposing every effort to roll back coverage, Brad Sherman has consistently put people over politics. With abortion access and reproductive freedom under attack, we need his continued leadership in Congress."
International Association of Fire Fighters
“Brad Sherman is a proven ally and has been a strong partner with frontline firefighters and paramedics. He has been an effective leader for public safety, fighting for critical resources and investments in life-saving fire fighting technologies. The International Association of Fire Fighters is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for Congress. He has always been there for firefighters — and we are pleased to support his re-election campaign.”
Los Angeles County Federation of Labor
“The Los Angeles County Federation of Labor is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election because he has been a consistent and effective champion for working families throughout his time in Congress. Brad has always stood with workers to protect good-paying jobs, defend collective bargaining, and make sure our economy works for everyone, not just those at the top. At a time when working people are under attack, we need Brad Sherman’s proven leadership and unwavering commitment to fighting for us in Washington.”
Equality California
“Brad Sherman has been a consistent and unwavering champion for LGBTQ+ equality in Congress. From fighting back against the Trump Administration's attacks to helping block anti-trans legislation in the House to working tirelessly to defend reproductive freedom and LGBTQ+ civil rights, Brad understands that our community deserves pro-equality champions who deliver results. Equality California is proud to endorse Brad Sherman for re-election because we know he will continue to be a strong ally and partner in the fight for full, lived equality for all.”
Avance Democratic Club
"Avance Democratic Club is pleased to give our enthusiastic support and endorsement to Congressman Brad Sherman. He has been a force for good in Congress, fighting back against Donald Trump and ICE, supporting immigrants, working people and our community. He is the best choice for the people of the 32nd District."
Southern California Armenian Democrats
"The Armenian community is united behind Congressman Brad Sherman. He has been one of the most vocal supporters of our community in the House of Representatives. Brad has been a leader who shows up, listens, is accessible, and who we know we can count on to fight for our community. We look forward to helping him get re-elected."
U.S. Senator Alex Padilla
"Brad Sherman protects families from rogue ICE operations - and he stands up to Trump."
U.S. Senator Adam Schiff
"Brad Sherman is a powerful voice for Southern California in Washington. When he speaks, people listen. And when he fights, he wins. We need Brad’s experience in Washington, fighting for us."
California Governor Gavin Newsom
"Brad Sherman has been a leader in the fight to protect the people of California against Donald Trump. He's been an effective member of Congress for the 32nd District, working to lift up working families, seniors, young people and our most vulnerable. We need Brad to keep up the fight for California in Congress. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election."
Congresswoman Maxine Waters
“Brad Sherman has never backed down from standing up for what’s right. Whether it’s protecting working families or fighting back against Donald Trump’s dangerous agenda, Brad has always been a strong and steady voice for justice. His experience and tenacity make him an invaluable member of Congress, and I’m proud to endorse him.”
Congresswoman Sarah McBride
“Brad Sherman has been a steadfast and effective champion for LGBTQ+ equality, standing strong against discrimination and using his leadership in Congress to advance dignity, safety, and freedom for all. From protecting marriage equality to fighting back against the Trump Administration's attacks on brave transgender servicemembers, Brad has never wavered. At this moment, when our fundamental freedoms are under constant threat, we must stand with proven leaders like Brad Sherman and work together to take back the House of Representatives so we can continue moving our country forward. I am proud to support my friend Brad Sherman for re-election.”
State Superintendent of Public Instruction Tony Thurmond
"Brad Sherman has been a longtime champion for public education, for working families and for our California values. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election for Congress. We need him to keep up the fight for California's students, public educators and working families."
California State Treasurer Fiona Ma, CPA
"Brad Sherman has been a deeply effective member of Congress on behalf of the people of California. He's been a champion for working women and men, helped pass President Obama's Affordable Care Act, invested more in fire fighting and emergency response, helped combat climate change by funding renewable energy like wind and solar and so much more. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election for Congress."
Assembly Democratic Caucus Chair Rick Chavez Zbur
“Brad Sherman has spent his career defending our California values — from protecting reproductive freedom and advancing LGBTQ+ equality to fighting climate change and standing strong against the Trump Administration’s lawless attacks on our communities. I know Brad will continue to be a champion for all Californians in Congress, and I’m proud to support him.”
Los Angeles City Councilmember Traci Park
"Brad Sherman has been an effective leader for our community in Congress. He's fought for critical public safety resources, infrastructure investments that have helped create local jobs and he's been a bold fighter for the people of Los Angeles for years. I am proud to endorse Brad Sherman's re-election to Congress."

KY Rep. Jim Gooch Jr. Endorses Andy Barr for U.S. Senate
Endorsements
November 10, 2025
Providence, Kentucky—
Today, Kentucky State Representative Jim Gooch Jr. (R-HD-12) endorsed Andy Barr for U.S. Senate.
“I’m endorsing Andy Barr because he’s the coal candidate,”
said Rep. Gooch, Chairman of the Natural Resources and Energy Committee
. “Andy will work with President Trump to put our miners back to work, see our energy industry boom, and prices go down for our communities. He will be a great U.S. Senator.”
“Chairman Gooch will be an incredible partner at the state level to revitalize our coal industry in Kentucky,”
said Barr.
“Together, we will make Kentucky the centerpiece of America’s energy dominance and create jobs for hardworking Kentuckians all over the Commonwealth. I’m honored to have Chairman Gooch’s endorsement and look forward to working with him when I’m in the U.S. Senate.”
Chairman Gooch was elected to the Kentucky State House in 1994. He represents Crittenden, McLean, Union, and Webster Counties in the State House. He was the former Mayor and a city councilman in Providence, Kentucky. He also currently works as an insurance agent.

Manchester Alderman Ed Sapienza is endorsing my campaign for Congress. Ed knows me well, he knows I’ll always stand strong for our Second Amendment rights. But let’s be real. I also want a rematch. Thanks, Ed. I appreciate the support and I’m still ready when you are.
State Representative Mary Murphy: "Brian Cole brings a level of sophistication, thoughtfulness, and integrity that is desperately needed in Washington. I have seen him be extremely effective. Brian knows how to get things done, build consensus, and fight for what matters. He is committed to making a real difference for New Hampshire families. We need someone who is not only tough but also smart someone who can navigate the chaos in D.C.
State Representative Jon Morton is endorsing Brian Cole for Congress, calling him “exactly what we need in Washington.” “Brian is the conservative we've needed for years someone with backbone, principles, and the drive to actually get things done. He’ll stand strong for New Hampshire and bring real leadership to Washington.” – Rep. Jon Morton
State Representative Bob Wherry is endorsing Brian Cole for Congress, highlighting Cole’s strong business background and commitment to New Hampshire. “I’ve worked with Brian Cole he’s thoughtful, hardworking, and always puts New Hampshire first. We need to support Brian because he’s going to get the job done for our state.” – Rep. Bob Wherry
State Representative Pierre DuPont is endorsing Brian Cole for Congress, calling him “a team player, a great guy, and exactly the kind of leader we need right now.” “When Brian gets to Washington,” DuPont says, “he’s going to shake things up - and that’s a good thing.”
State Representative Linda McGrath on Team Cole! In her interview, she said she’s behind me 100% and that means everything. Like President Trump, I’m fighting to put America First, secure our borders, and protect our freedoms. With Linda’s support and your help, we’re going to take this race over the finish line and send a real fighter to Washington!
Rick Blais of Manchester, New Hampshire, is supporting Brian Cole for Congress, calling him “a true gentleman and a genuinely good guy.” Rick says what sets Brian apart is his willingness to work with anyone to get the job done a quality he believes makes Brian the best choice to represent New Hampshire in Washington.

KY Rep. Stephanie Dietz Endorses Andy Barr for U.S. Senate
Endorsements
February 17, 2026
Edgewood, Kentucky—
Today, Kentucky State Representative Stephanie Dietz (R-HD-65) endorsed Andy Barr for U.S. Senate.
“I’m proud to endorse Andy Barr for the United States Senate,”
said Rep. Dietz.
“Andy has the experience to hit the ground running on day one. He has consistently stood with law enforcement and delivered real results for Kentucky families. In the Senate, Andy will continue fighting to keep our communities safe, strengthen our economy, and protect the values that make Kentucky strong. He will be a great champion for Northern Kentucky.”
“I’m honored to have Rep. Dietz’s support,”
said Barr.
“Stephanie has been a strong voice for Northern Kentucky, working tirelessly to protect families, support law enforcement, and ensure safer communities. She understands that backing the blue and defending Kentucky values go hand in hand. I look forward to partnering with her to continue delivering for hardworking families across the Commonwealth.”
Representative Dietz was first elected in 2022. The 65th District includes parts of Kenton County in Northern Kentucky, including Covington, Crestview Hills, Edgewood, Park Hills and Ft. Wright. An attorney with nearly three decades of experience practicing family law, Dietz has focused her legislative efforts on public safety and protecting Kentucky families.
Barr has over 160 major
endorsements
in the U.S. Senate race, more than all of his Republican opponents combined. Rep. Dietz joins 20 other Kentucky Representatives in backing Barr’s campaign.

Kentucky Professional Fire Fighters Unanimously Endorses Andy Barr for Senate
Endorsements
May 22, 2025
The largest association of professional firefighters and emergency medical technicians (EMTs) is behind Barr
Lexington, Kentucky—
Today, U.S. Senate candidate Andy Barr (R-KY) scored major endorsements: the International Association of Fire Fighters (IAFF) and the Kentucky Professional Fire Fighters (KPFF), the IAFF’s Kentucky affiliate. The IAFF represents 356,000 professional firefighters and EMTs. Barr has long championed Kentucky firefighters and EMTs in Congress, and has been endorsed by IAFF six times.
“Our firefighters and EMT professionals are heroes,”
said Andy Barr.
“Firefighters and EMT professionals often risk their lives to serve our communities and keep us safe. I’m honored to have the endorsement of the KPFF and IAFF, which represents these great Americans in Kentucky and nationwide. I’m looking forward to being their champion in the U.S. Senate.”
“The KPFF’s unanimous decision reflects Congressman Barr’s strong record of supporting key fire fighter priorities during his tenure in the U.S. House of Representatives,”
said KPFF President Joe Baer.
“From expanding the AFG and SAFER grant programs to repealing the unfair WEP and GPO penalties on retirees – and on many more issues in between – Congressman Andy Barr has stood with fire fighters and their families when it matters most,”
said International Association of Fire Fighters General President Edward Kelly.
“The IAFF looks forward to him continuing his support for Kentucky’s fire fighters in the U.S. Senate.”

questions.label: Is the named endorser present on the page?
questions.help: Yes when the named person or entity appears on the page. The candidate's own statements, calls to endorse, and generic supporter counts are not endorsements.

questions.label: Is the endorser name copied and separated correctly?
questions.help: endorser_name identifies the person or entity only. Title, affiliation, and jurisdiction belong in their own fields and must not sit inside the name.

questions.label: Are entity type and endorser category correct?
questions.help: entity_type is individual, organization, or unclear. endorser_category is private_individual, government_official, party_official, labor_union, media_outlet, other_organization, other_individual, or unclear. Judge both from the page alone. unclear is correct when the page gives no basis to choose; unclear is wrong when the page states the basis.

questions.label: Are title, affiliation, and jurisdiction correct or correctly null?
questions.help: These three fields are separate and nullable. They must never be combined into a generic organization field and must never be inferred. Null is correct whenever the page does not state the value.

questions.label: Does record evidence support the endorser identity?
questions.help: record_evidence is one exact name-bearing span. It may include adjacent title or jurisdiction text to make it unique. Yes when it establishes who the endorser is.

questions.label: Do record and context evidence together establish this endorsement?
questions.help: support_mode is explicit_text only when record_evidence itself states support; a bare name never qualifies. Otherwise support_mode is page_or_section_context and the context evidence must establish why the name-bearing record is an endorsement.
